# RFC-0014: Wiki links

## Abstract

An unresolved link to [[Some Unknown Thing]] that archdoc link would expand.

## Motivation

To make L16 fire.

## Proposal

A link inside `[[inline code]]` is not a wiki link, and neither is one in a
fenced block:

```
[[not a link either]]
```

## Alternatives considered

None.

## Backwards compatibility

Nothing.
